description.text: "3+1” Undergraduate Program Courses will be finished within the first 3 years, combining a fourth year internship in IT companies either domestically or abroad. Students will grasp software engineering knowledge and skills as well as strengthening the following abilities after graduation. Lifelong learning ability Problem-solving capacity Communication and expression ability Teamwork spirit Innovation and entrepreneurship ability Practical skills of English Our curriculum emphasizes students’ fundamental skills and is application oriented. Specialty courses have a flexible structure which combined fundamental courses with electives. Students can tailor their studies to meet their own interests. Fundamental courses Calculus Geometry and Algebra Probability & Statistics Program Design Basics Object-Oriented Programming & Design Introduction to Software Engineering Data Structures & Algorithm Analysis Discrete Mathematics Operating System Database Systems Technology Writing and Presentation Skills Electives Introduction to Computer Systems Computer Composition Principle Introduction to Digital Media Basic of Computer Network System Analysis and Design Software Architecture Software Project Organization & Management Networks & Distributed Program Design System-Level Programming Software Specification, Testing and Maintenance Web-based Application Development Embedded Systems Design

duration.text: The Computer Software Engineering in English at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4027 USD/per year ￥ 29000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English or OR pass Entrance Oral English Test organized by SSE

requirements.text: Applicants should be 18-60 years old and successfully complete high school study and get an official certificate domestically. (The high school study equivalent to 12 years study in western countries)
